bloodlines.description: Long ago a small village was under threat of destruction. Sandwiched between 3 warring nations, each sought to claim the village as their own and demanded the chief swear loyalty to them. However, the chief knew that swearing loyalty to any one would spell destruction as the other two would surely attack. Secretly, he tasked his only daughter to go find help, but no one wanted to get involved and risk war from the 3 powerful nations. So, she turned to the only place she could, the underworld. She began making summoning contracts with smaller lesser powerful beasts, collecting allies until she had enough strength to recruit more powerful entities. And when she was finally done, she had amassed a force nearing a thousand. 999 Demons had made a contract with her, offering up a portion of their power. When the deadline came for the village chief to swear loyalty, his daughter returned with her new found power and struck down the ambassadors of each nation. Normally, this would mean eradication, however, she had become so powerful that she was able to take on the forces of all 3 nations with her summoned demons. When the dust cleared, all 3 nations were no more and that small village had annexed them all. Unfortunately, however, the village chief's daughter had to pay the ultimate price. By overusing the powers granted to her, she had, tragically, become a demon herself. The village chief had to seal her and her army away into his own granddaughter. With time and many wars, the village eventually was destroyed and the seal gradually weakened. Now on the night of a lunar eclipse, the moon tinted blood red, the seal finally broke and the Night Parade begins.
bloodlines.name: Night Parade of A Thousand Demons

bloodlines.description:
In the ancient annals of Current's genesis, the villagers remained oblivious to Fujin's unleashed fury within the valleys. But as raging tempests laid waste to their crops and made life a daily struggle, they erected an altar to appease Fujin's wrath, offering sacrifices for mercy. Though momentarily effective, peace proved short-lived.

 

On a fateful afternoon, children playing near the sacred altar accidentally desecrated it, reigniting Fujin's wrath. Hurricane-force winds tore through the village, reducing even the altar to rubble. Amidst the chaos, a young member of the Aerathiel lineage emerged. With unwavering determination, she faced the storm, her skin lashed by winds like a whip. Carrying a heavy stone from the ruined altar, she planted it where it once stood, offering her life for her people's salvation. Fujin, moved by her selfless devotion, softened, transforming the hurricane into a gentle breeze. Legend has it that Aerathiel descendants inherit divine mastery of the wind element, from destructive gusts to soothing melodies in wind chimes.
bloodlines.name: Aerathiel

Wind, Earth, and Dust give Aerathiel its identity. The foundation below brings together its full bloodline kit; the player’s build and tactical choices follow after it.

intro: Night Parade of A Thousand Demons is an H-rank summoning bloodline. A pact with the underworld gives its wielder a supporting cast of demons, turning a single shinobi’s battle into a sustained procession.

Its elemental identity spans Shadow, Earth, Water, Wind, and non-elemental techniques. The Underworld Gate, complete bloodline kit, and summon abilities are included below, before the player’s own strategy begins.

modules.description: The Gate’s captured summon links lead to these three patrons. Their abilities are part of the bloodline foundation, separate from the jutsu you equip. AI ability values below use their captured equipped level, not the player-jutsu level.
modules.title: The Underworld Procession

templates.overview: The gate gives the bloodline its rhythm. Around it, the core kit combines damage, control, and sustain: Possessing Yurei disrupts action points, Oni Hammer Swing reduces damage given, and Otherworldly Conduit supports a committed exchange.
